outputs.explanation: Scatter plot where each point is an individual sample (n=141); marginal histograms show raw distributions. Scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional individual-point overlays.
Scatter plot (mean ± s.d. per cell line/reporter) with error bars conveying variability across replicates. Scatter plots are exempt per the check's rules.
Density/line curves showing distributions of period and amplitude by subtype. Line plots are exempt since overlaying individual points would be unreadable.
Box plot, which is inherently exempt as it already displays the data distribution; individual colored data points are additionally overlaid on the boxes.
Polar histogram showing binned distribution of Bmal1-Per2 phase differences over time per cell line; histograms represent binned raw data and are exempt from requiring point overlays.
Polar histogram averaged by subtype; as a histogram-type distribution plot it is exempt from needing individual data point overlays.
Line plot of an original signal trace with a fitted exponential-sinusoidal model; line plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
Scatter plot of amplitude vs. decay rate per sample with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty. Scatter plots are exempt per the check's rules.
